title: Evidence-backed competitive matrix
objective: Measure whether the competitive-analysis craftbook creates a complete cited matrix and a recommendation grounded in seeded competitor facts.
prompt: In the `Competitive Analysis Eval` project, read `source/competitor-briefs.md` and write `analysis.md`: compare HarborCRM against AtlasOps, Deskline, and RelayFlow across target customer, pricing, automations, integrations, reporting, and weaknesses. Include a markdown comparison matrix, sources/citations from the seeded briefs, competitive gaps, and a recommendation for where HarborCRM should compete.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for competitive-analysis. All competitor facts are seeded in workspace/source/competitor-briefs.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Write a cited competitive analysis with a complete matrix, evidence-backed cells, competitive gaps, and a recommendation tied to the seeded facts.

files.content:
# Seeded competitor evidence

[1] HarborCRM: Our product for regional wholesalers. Pricing is $149/user/month. Strengths: EDI order follow-up, inventory-aware reminders, native QuickBooks and NetSuite exports. Weaknesses: no built-in AI email summarization, reporting is CSV-first.

[2] AtlasOps: Targets enterprise operations teams. Pricing starts at $40k/year platform fee plus seats. Strengths: workflow automations, approval routing, SSO, audit logs. Weaknesses: slow onboarding and limited wholesale-specific templates.

[3] Deskline: Targets SMB support teams. Pricing is $79/user/month. Strengths: shared inbox, AI email summaries, helpdesk integrations, fast setup. Weaknesses: weak inventory context and no EDI order workflow.

[4] RelayFlow: Targets logistics coordinators. Pricing is usage-based at $0.08/order event. Strengths: carrier tracking integrations, exception alerts, SLA dashboards. Weaknesses: not a CRM, limited account history, weak finance exports.

success.summary: workspace/analysis.md contains a complete cited matrix, all four products, all dimensions, competitive gaps, and an evidence-tied recommendation.
